name: Rénald Athlion
source:
A disciple of Yggdrasill, Rénald has settled in the village of Ithaca to train his pupil in the use of arms. Beyond combat, he strives to impart a true philosophy of life, aiming to inspire his apprentice toward grand ambitions. Both a gifted athlete and a profound thinker, he hopes his teachings will encourage others to bring out the best in themselves.

A man with a passion for the sea, he is a prodigious sailor who excels in the art of fishing. He occasionally hints at having traveled to many distant lands, yet he refuses to speak of his past. He clams up entirely when questioned and does not hesitate to be blunt with those who persist.

He considers his first steps into his Lord’s Temple to have been a second birth.
